optimizer_state_candidate.finding: The primary paper already isolates first-moment carryover that leaves present parameters and outputs unchanged but changes later source-free learning. This covers the proposed carrier and causal intervention. Restricting a future attack to genuine environment experience would need an additional conceptual contribution.

candidates.decision: Not accepted as a new mechanism.
candidates.reason: Optimizing action rankings without large average prediction error overlaps the existing TD-MPC2 action-search experiment, which already measured candidate ranking changes without held-out task loss. Ranking regression gates also require a distinct algorithmic contribution beyond a protected replay test.

candidates.mathematical_gate: For a fully observed Markov system, holding initial law, policy and all relevant conditional transition kernels fixed fixes the path law: p(s0,a0,...,sH)=p(s0) product_t pi(at|ht) P(st+1|st,at). With the same reward functional, the return law is also fixed. Thus changing trajectory risk while preserving all full one-step conditionals is not available under these assumptions.
candidates.qualification: Equal marginal errors or means do not imply equal conditional kernels. Partial observation, differing histories, reward dependence or incompletely matched distributions can admit correlation effects; this argument does not rule them out. The generated proposal has not supplied a distinct exploitable mechanism in those cases.
candidates.code_limit: CausalGame and WorldEvolver are not native Dreamer or TD-MPC2 training backends. The proposed combination would need an explicit research implementation and cannot be called an existing native pipeline.

decision: No accepted broad mechanism or new task-harm evidence. Avoid another optimizer-state transplant reproduction or an ill-specified marginal-matching experiment.
report_note_cn: 机制与正向方法仍未建立足够新颖性。功能保持的学习几何调制、纠错停止核、经验晋升为共享技能，均找到对应已有操作。前轮在原样 OPINE 学习代码中复现了查询改变隐藏记忆；本轮确认上游提示已要求规划分支的连续性保护，且原生规划短测未触发该现象，因此停止把它作为新概念扩展。新核对的原始论文还明确覆盖未来可纠正性、学习获取证据的能力，以及机制记忆的选择性更新；这些泛化表述不能直接计为我们的贡献。后续独立方法评议的主、备用请求均超时，无回复。本轮没有新增环境实验或GPU工作，尚无新方法优势可支持扩大实验。

decisions.candidate: Model equivalence after real feedback correction
decisions.decision: The proposed operator is an existing option/SMDP model, not a distinct method.
decisions.operator: T_r V(q) = E[sum_{t<tau} gamma^t c_t + gamma^tau V(q_tau)]
decisions.reason: q must include the environment and all future-relevant agent state. Cost, duration and terminal-state law for a fixed correction protocol are standard option-model quantities. Policy changes require a protocol family; equal observed states alone do not certify confluence.

decisions.candidate: Shared experience changes reusable skill instructions
decisions.decision: Keep SkillClaw as a possible future experimental carrier, not an original mechanism.
decisions.reason: PoisonedEvolution already studies evidence promotion and attribution into persistent skills in SkillClaw and Trace2Skill.

gradient_clipping_construction.identities: h_prime=(1+b)*(P_r-1); f_hat_prime=-b+(1+b)*P_r; sup forward error <= epsilon*(1+b)/2; the derivative mean across a full phase period is 1.
gradient_clipping_construction.finite_batch_limit: For independent uniform phases and any fixed finite batch B, E[clip_C(mean_i f_hat_prime_i)] tends to -min(b,C) as r tends to 1. Follows from almost-sure convergence and bounded convergence after clipping.

native_parameters.clip_order: aggregate actor loss, backward, then global parameter-gradient clipping

gradient_clipping_construction.scope: Does not prove implementation in the native finite network, persistence after real-data refit, Adam update reversal or task harm. The 4096 actor-time terms are not independent scalar phases.
gradient_clipping_construction.decision: No GPU run. The reversal mechanism instantiates established asymmetric-gradient clipping bias; no novel optimizer-aware model-learning algorithm supplied.
